thread:
pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident triggered — high 5xx rate on canary pool 'dedicated-pool-7' (alert: canary-5xx-rate > 5% for 2m). Link: https://redwood.alerts/INC-2092

deploy-bot: deploying commit 3f8a7e -> canary group dedicated-pool-7 at 14:03 UTC. rollout strategy: 5% -> 25% over 10m.

jess: saw the PD page. canary 5xxs are from model-runtime returning 502, not LB timeouts. grabbing logs.

omar: oncall here. @jess can you paste the top error? any stack?

jess: logs show repeated: 
```
2026-11-05T14:04:12Z runtime ERROR inference/runtime.cpp:421 - KV_CACHE_MISS_TOO_FREQUENT: eviction thrash detected, falling back to sync path
2026-11-05T14:04:12Z runtime WARN http/handler.cpp:88 - upstream responded 502 Bad Gateway
```

riley: hmm kv-cache thrash after the new conn-pool/async-io change in the canary. that codepath was gated behind flag `async_kv_pool_v2`.

maya: can confirm traffic pattern spiked on long-context requests right after canary started. latency also increasing.

omar: paging rotation, I'm calling an incident. @kai you'll take triage? pinging SRE lead.

kai: on it. first check: are healthchecks failing?

jess: healthcheck probe status: 3/5 nodes failing basic /healthz with 503. Probe output snippet: `status: degraded, kv-cache-errors: 12/min`

sam: UI/metrics show 12% 5xx for the canary slice. customer-facing only in region-us-west-2. volume low but errors persistent.

kai: actionable plan: 1) abort canary rollout via kill-switch flag, 2) scale canary down to 0, 3) roll back to previous commit if needed. Who can flip kill-switch?

riley: I can flip the runtime feature flag. running: `./ops/feature-toggle set async_kv_pool_v2=false --env canary --author riley`

deploy-bot: Received rollback/flag request. Initiating feature toggle change.

deploy-bot: Feature toggled: async_kv_pool_v2=false for cluster dedicated-pool-7 at 14:09 UTC.

jess: flag change propagated to 5/5 canary nodes. starting to monitor.

(2m later)

maya: 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% on slice, healthchecks back to 5/5 passing. latency returning to baseline.

kai: good signal. leaving follow-up steps: abort the remainder of the canary rollout and keep canary at 0 until we root cause. set canary_abort=true in rollout config.

riley: done: `rollout abort --group dedicated-pool-7 --reason "kv-cache thrash via async_kv_pool_v2"`

deploy-bot: Canary rollout aborted. No further traffic will be shifted. Previous stable remains serving.

omar: documenting impact: did we see any customer errors? which tenants affected?

sam: only a handful of tenant requests in us-west-2 got 502s. I cross-checked correlation IDs from logs — roughly 24 unique customer requests over ~7 minutes. No major customers impacted.

jess: capturing artifact: collected runtime logs, heap profiles, and kv-cache metrics. uploading to incident storage: https://internal.s3/redwood/incidents/2092001111/artifacts

kai: immediate mitigation success. next: postmortem tasks — repro with async_kv_pool_v2 toggled on at higher load, run kv cache stress harness, add graceful degradation for KV thrash (backoff + soft-fail) and add a healthcheck that inspects kv-cache error rate.

riley: I'll create a PR with conservative defaults (backoff window 50ms -> 200ms) and a canary gating test before re-enabling.

omar: handoff to on-call tomorrow at 08:00 UTC. I'll attach runbook notes and the temporary suppressions.

jess: note for postmortem: timeline, why flag was allowed to ship without synthetic long-context load test, how to detect early (kv-cache error metric), mitigation steps taken.

kai: reassigning P0 -> P2 (no major customer outage). leaving incident open for root cause and follow-up. tagging people for follow-ups: @riley (fix), @jess (logs + repro), @sam (customer comms if needed).

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2092 updated: status -> mitigated, severity -> SEV2, assignees: riley,jess.

sam: will draft a short customer note saying there was a brief spike of 502s limited to canary region; no major impact. will share copy in #customer-impact for review. :thumbsup:

riley: adding unit/integration tests for async_kv_pool_v2 and enabling CI gate. will link PR in follow-up.

jess: saving thread logs and closing Slack thread once postmortem created. thanks team. :heart:
